name: Cindy Lee
label: Realistik
lede: Women fell apart mid-set in Victoria in 2010. [[Patrick Flegel]] spent the next decade making drag-pop records as Cindy Lee that almost nobody could find, then put a 32-song album on YouTube and a GeoCities-style site, and Pitchfork gave it a 9.1.

eras.title: Two albums, then a bar fight
eras.text: Women came out of Calgary with a debut recorded in a basement and a culvert, then a second record that critics still rank among the decade's best. The tour behind it ended in a fistfight.

years.src: Wikipedia: Women (band) · Stereogum: Women Brawl, Break Up?
years.h: Four Calgary friends start Women
years.p: Brothers [[Patrick Flegel|35a5d8f3-e394-4f5e-9b11-2d1049e7827f]] and [[Matt Flegel|96c7a09f-bbd2-4b91-a91a-33a58ba417bb]] team up with drummer Mike Wallace and guitarist Chris Reimer. Flemish Eye's Ian Russell later calls them friends since elementary school.
years.xp: Patrick played guitar and sang, Matt played bass and percussion, Wallace drummed and Reimer played guitar and samples. Both albums came out on Calgary's Flemish Eye in Canada and on Jagjaguwar in the US.

years.h: Women's debut gets made in a basement, a culvert and a crawlspace
years.p: [[Chad VanGaalen|d5c5c11b-153d-4f28-9525-db5ec1bfe0ad]] recorded it with the band between December 2007 and February 2008. Pitchfork gave it a 7.9.
years.xp:
VanGaalen worked in his Calgary basement, an outdoor culvert and a crawlspace, with boom boxes and tape machines standing in for a studio. Flemish Eye released it in Canada and Jagjaguwar in the US. Pitchfork ranked "Black Rice" No. 18 among the best songs of 2008.

Wikipedia counts more than 180 shows across North America and Europe over 2008 and 2009.

years.h: Public Strain takes ten months at Yoko Eno
years.p: VanGaalen produces again, at his own Calgary studio. Pitchfork gives it an 8.0 and it makes the 2011 Polaris longlist.
years.xp:
The band spent about ten months at Yoko Eno. Wikipedia's album page gives the release date as August 23, 2010 and its Women page says September 28, so the page sticks to the year.

"Eyesore," the closing track, is the one fans and critics name first. Sputnikmusic later put the record third on its decade list.

years.src: Exclaim!: Women Implode Onstage in BC · Stereogum: Women Brawl, Break Up?
years.h: Women split onstage at Lucky Bar in Victoria
years.p: A witness said Patrick Flegel threw punches at Matt Flegel during soundcheck. Onstage, Patrick told the room it was about to see the last show.
years.xp:
Exclaim! quoted Patrick: "we're breaking up right now, you're all going to see our last show." After about five songs Reimer and Matt left the stage and Wallace followed. Patrick smashed Matt's guitar against an amp.

The label cancelled Vancouver, Ymir, Edmonton and a European tour. Ian Russell of Flemish Eye said the band needed a break after two months on the road, and asked for privacy for what he called a close-knit group of friends since elementary school.

eras.title: Chris Reimer dies; Cindy Lee takes shape
eras.text: Women never played again. Reimer died, the Flegel brothers went separate ways, and Patrick Flegel began releasing the music that would become Cindy Lee.

years.src: Exclaim!: Christopher Reimer's Cause of Death Revealed · Spin: Posthumous Collection by Late Women Guitarist Chris Reimer
years.h: Women guitarist Chris Reimer dies at 26
years.p: The label said he died in his sleep of complications related to a heart condition. The funeral was in Calgary on February 29.
years.xp:
On the day of the funeral, Women's labels ran a coordinated listening event and asked fans to play both albums back to back. His family set up a memorial fund.

Flemish Eye later released Hello People, a double LP of Reimer's four-track and phone-memo recordings compiled by friends and family, on April 19, 2018.

years.h: Matt Flegel and Mike Wallace start Viet Cong
years.p: Guitarists Scott Munro and Daniel Christiansen join them in Calgary. After criticism of the name, the band becomes Preoccupations in April 2016.
years.xp: Viet Cong put out a self-titled album in 2015 and had a March 2015 show at Oberlin College cancelled over the name before the switch to [[Preoccupations|9ee1988d-66ec-4c29-98d6-876a45e0fcbd]].

years.src: Wikipedia: Cindy Lee (band) · Kool Kids Music Club
years.h: Patrick Flegel and Morgan Cook record as Androgynous Mind
years.p: Per Wikipedia, their Nightstalker EP is where the Cindy Lee project comes from. Tatlashea follows on Isolated Now Waves on Boxing Day.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists Tatlashea as a Boxing Day 2012 release, reissued in 2016. Early Cindy Lee records came out in tiny runs on small labels, which is part of why the project stayed under the radar for a decade.

eras.title: A drag act nobody could find
eras.text: Flegel kept releasing records as Cindy Lee through small labels, cassette runs and split singles, performing in drag over recorded backing.

years.h: Cindy Lee and Red Mass split a single on Mongrel Zine
years.p: Cindy Lee's side is "Holding the Devil's Hand," one of the first releases after Women.

years.src: The FADER: Patrick Flegel on creating the haunted pop universe of Cindy Lee · Wikipedia: Cindy Lee (band)
years.h: The FADER dates Cindy Lee's arrival to Act of Tenderness
years.p: CCQSK released it in 2015, and Maple Death and W.25th reissued it in 2018.
years.xp:
The FADER describes Flegel drawing on the suburban closet-queen figure, Faye Dunaway, Patsy Cline and Akihiro Miwa. Both 2015 albums got the 2018 reissue.

In 2015 Flegel also toured as a live member of [[Freak Heat Waves|7197c548-ec59-4e59-80ef-56901a80e1ef]].

years.h: Malenkost follows the same year on Isolated Now Waves
years.p: Force Exposure's catalog pairs Brill Building hooks with No Wave noise.

years.src: Spin: Posthumous Collection by Late Women Guitarist Chris Reimer
years.h: Hello People collects Chris Reimer's four-track recordings
years.p: Flemish Eye's double LP, compiled by friends and family, also holds his phone memos.

years.h: Model Express goes out on 100 gold cassettes
years.p: CCQSK put out the compilation. W.25th pressed it to vinyl in 2020.

eras.title: Karen Carpenter and the lathe cuts
eras.text: Cindy Lee signed to a real label and landed on the Polaris longlist, then went back to editions of 50.

years.src: Wikipedia: What's Tonight to Eternity? · The FADER: Patrick Flegel on creating the haunted pop universe of Cindy Lee
years.h: What's Tonight to Eternity? takes on Karen Carpenter
years.p: W.25th released it on Valentine's Day 2020. Flegel recorded almost all of it alone at Realistik Studios.
years.xp:
Flegel told The FADER about compiling a two-and-a-half-hour personal biography of Carpenter. Her overwork, and the people feeding on her career, resonated with Flegel's own mental health during the Women touring years.

Andrew Flegel played drums.

years.src: Force Exposure: Cindy Lee · Wikipedia: Cindy Lee (band)
years.h: Cat o' Nine Tails comes out as 50 lathe cuts
years.p: Realistik pressed the 50 copies, per Force Exposure. Isolated Now Waves gave it a wider release in 2023.
years.xp: Force Exposure lists it as originally 50 lathe-cut copies, combining classic songwriting with classical composition.

years.h: Pitchfork gives the Carpenter record a 7.1, Exclaim! a 9/10
years.p: Paste gave What's Tonight to Eternity? an 8.4. It made the Polaris longlist and did not reach the shortlist.

years.src: Wikipedia: Cindy Lee (band) · Jacksonville Music Experience: Cindy Lee interview
years.h: "In a Moment Divine" goes to the disco floor on Mood Hut
years.p: Freak Heat Waves members Steven Lind and Thomas Di Ninno reshape an Amanda Lear-inspired original.
years.xp: Freak Heat Waves became Cindy Lee's closest allies. Lind co-wrote "Baby Blue" on Diamond Jubilee and mixed it, and the band opened the 2024 tour.

eras.title: The album that lived on a website
eras.text: A double album appears on YouTube and a site built like 1998. A few weeks later, Pitchfork gives it a 9.1.

years.cap: Cindy Lee at Soda Bar, San Diego, April 2024
years.src: NPR: How Cindy Lee became · Talkhouse: Not Lost in the Shuffle Again · Uproxx: Why Cindy Lee's Diamond Jubilee
years.h: Thirty-two songs go up on YouTube and a GeoCities-style site
years.p: Two hours, no Spotify. Flegel suggested a $30 Canadian donation for the WAV download.
years.xp:
The album lived on a single two-hour YouTube video and on the Realistik Studios site. NPR quoted the site's line about Spotify's chief executive: "THE CEO OF SPOTIFY IS A THIEF AND A WAR PIG." NPR also quoted Flegel: "I'd much rather bet on myself."

Flegel played nearly every part on digital 8-track, with synths from Steven Lind of [[Freak Heat Waves|7197c548-ec59-4e59-80ef-56901a80e1ef]]. Talkhouse heard a turn toward warmth and accessibility after six darker records, with girl groups, reggae and Thin Lizzy-style guitar harmonies in the mix.

years.big: "A foggy transmission from a rock 'n' roll netherworld."
years.src: Album of the Year: Diamond Jubilee · Wikipedia: Diamond Jubilee (album) · Paste: Diamond Jubilee review
years.h: Pitchfork's 9.1 is its highest score in four years
years.p: Andy Cush's description of each song, in a review that ran weeks after release for a record with no promotion. Paste gave it a 9.2 and Metacritic averaged 91.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, it was Pitchfork's highest new-album rating since Fiona Apple's 2020 release. Cush also called the album "an essential trove of music."

It went to No. 1 on RateYourMusic and topped year-end lists at Exclaim!, Gorilla vs. Bear and Beats Per Minute.

years.src: Uproxx: Why Cindy Lee's Diamond Jubilee · NPR: How Cindy Lee became
yt: Full set, Soda Bar, San Diego, April 19, 2024
years.h: The Diamond Jubilee tour opens with Freak Heat Waves
years.p: Flegel plays in drag over backing tracks: sequin dress, fur coat, blue wig, falsetto.
years.xp:
Uproxx described the show as full theatrical drag over pre-recorded tracks. NPR, at Cactus Club in Milwaukee on May 3, saw a black beehive wig, a gold sequined dress and white New Balance sneakers, and a 45-minute set on a cherry Telecaster played without a strap.

The show was billed for 10 p.m. and started closer to 11. Between songs the room got a muffled "thank you."

years.cap: Patrick Flegel as Cindy Lee at the Cactus Club, Milwaukee, May 3, 2024
years.src: Exclaim!: Cindy Lee Cancels the Remainder of 2024 Tour · NPR: How Cindy Lee became · Stereogum: Cindy Lee Announces First Concerts
years.h: Cindy Lee cancels the tour hours before a Chicago show
years.p: About 12 dates, including Toronto and Montreal, are dropped. Venue Tubby's says "personal reasons"; Freak Heat Waves say it's beyond their control.
years.xp: Exclaim! reported the cancellation on May 5. Milwaukee on May 3 was the last performance of the run. Stereogum later noted that Flegel gave no statement as to why.

years.h: Panda Bear and Moon Diagrams both bring in Flegel
years.p: Noah Lennox of Animal Collective releases the single "Defense" as Panda Bear with Flegel. Deerhunter's Moses Archuleta puts out Cemetery Classics as Moon Diagrams, also with Flegel.

years.h: An album that lives on YouTube makes the Polaris shortlist
years.p: The Canadian prize shortlists Diamond Jubilee on July 11, 2024, with a self-hosted website as its other home.

years.h: Bandcamp and a triple LP put the album on shelves
years.p: Cindy Lee moves the catalog to Bandcamp. Superior Viaduct's W.25th imprint issues the album on triple LP and double CD.

eras.title: Pitchfork's No. 1, then a return to the stage
eras.text: Pitchfork named it album of the year, later ranked it third among the 2020s so far, and Cindy Lee went back out in bigger rooms.

years.cap: Patrick Flegel as Cindy Lee, fall 2025
years.src: Wikipedia: Diamond Jubilee (album) · Album of the Year: Diamond Jubilee
years.h: Pitchfork puts Diamond Jubilee at No. 1 for 2024
years.p: Exclaim! and Gorilla vs. Bear also pick it first.
years.xp: Pitchfork placed it ahead of the rest of its 50 best albums of the year, and later ranked it third on its best albums of the 2020s so far, per Wikipedia.

years.cap: Patrick Flegel as Cindy Lee on stage, fall 2025
years.src: Stereogum: Cindy Lee Announces First Concerts · Paste: Diamond Jubilee review
years.h: Cindy Lee returns to the stage in fall 2025
years.p: Empty Bottle in Chicago on November 5, Massey Hall in Toronto on the 6th, Rialto Theatre in Montreal on the 10th and Brooklyn Paramount on the 15th, with Freak Heat Waves on three.
years.xp: Stereogum announced the dates on August 12, 2025 as the first shows since the curtailed spring 2024 run. Flegel had hinted the run might be Cindy Lee's last American tour.
